rules.name: cs-10-all-clients-statement-parity-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT 'legacy valuation_date_table' AS what, value_date, settlement_date, NULL AS row_count FROM dbsystemuat.valuation_date_table UNION ALL SELECT 'legacy statement cache', max(value_date), NULL, count(*) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs UNION ALL SELECT 'legacy security prices current table', :valueDate, NULL, count(*) FROM dbsystemuat.security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'legacy security prices history table', :valueDate, NULL, count(*) FROM dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate

SELECT CASE WHEN max(value_date) = :valueDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS legacy_cache_on_value_date, max(value_date) AS legacy_cache_date FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs

SELECT 'new valuation_date_table' AS what, value_date, settlement_date, NULL::bigint AS row_count, updated_timestamp AS written_at FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' UNION ALL SELECT 'new statement cache', value_date, NULL, count(*), max(created_timestamp) FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY value_date UNION ALL SELECT 'new security prices last written', value_date, NULL, count(*), max(coalesce(updated_timestamp, created_timestamp)) FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate GROUP BY value_date

SELECT trade_id, contract_number, counterparty_parent, security_id, subportfolio, market_action, transaction_date, original_lots, premium, netting_status, netting_date, is_fixing_done, fixing_date, opt_periodicity, deal_status, trade_source FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs WHERE subportfolio LIKE 'RMS%' AND transaction_date < :valueDate AND counterparty_parent <> 'JPM9A400'

SELECT trade_id, contract_number, counterparty_parent, security_id, subportfolio, market_action, transaction_date, original_lots, premium, netting_status, netting_date, is_fixing_done, fixing_date, opt_periodicity, deal_status, trade_source FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND is_latest_version = 1 AND subportfolio LIKE 'RMS%' AND transaction_date < :valueDate AND counterparty_parent <> 'JPM9A400'

SELECT d.trade_id, d.contract_number, d.premium AS traded_price FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs d JOIN (SELECT a.trade_id FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a JOIN (SELECT trade_id, max(value_date) AS value_date FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs WHERE value_date <= :valueDate GROUP BY trade_id) m ON m.trade_id = a.trade_id AND m.value_date = a.value_date WHERE a.active_lots != 0) l ON l.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE d.subportfolio LIKE 'RMS%' AND d.transaction_date < :valueDate AND d.counterparty_parent <> 'JPM9A400'

WITH lal AS ( SELECT trade_id FROM opera.latest_active_lot WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND active_lots <> 0 ), dt_price AS ( SELECT dt.trade_id, max(dt.premium) AS premium FROM opera.deal_ticket_table dt WHERE dt.tenant_id = :tenant AND dt.is_latest_version = 1 AND dt.premium IS NOT NULL AND dt.trade_id IN (SELECT trade_id FROM lal) GROUP BY dt.trade_id HAVING count(DISTINCT dt.premium) = 1 ) SELECT c.trade_id, c.contract_number, CASE WHEN p.premium IS NOT NULL AND round(p.premium::numeric, 4) = c.premium THEN p.premium::double precision ELSE c.premium::double precision END AS traded_price FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c JOIN lal ON lal.trade_id = c.trade_id LEFT JOIN dt_price p ON p.trade_id = c.trade_id WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.is_latest_version = 1 AND c.subportfolio LIKE 'RMS%' AND c.transaction_date < :valueDate AND c.counterparty_parent <> 'JPM9A400'

SELECT a.trade_id, a.value_date AS lots_date, a.active_lots FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a JOIN (SELECT trade_id, max(value_date) AS value_date FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs WHERE value_date <= :valueDate GROUP BY trade_id) m ON m.trade_id = a.trade_id AND m.value_date = a.value_date
SELECT trade_id, value_date AS lots_date, active_lots FROM opera.latest_active_lot WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT security_id, derivative_type, product_code, currency, contract_month, maturity_date, underlying1_id, underlying2_id, strike, strike1, strike2, barrier_type, barrier1_level, barrier2_level, averaging_startdate, averaging_enddate FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs

SELECT security_id, derivative_type, product_code, currency, contract_month, maturity_date, underlying1_id, underlying2_id, strike, strike1, strike2, barrier_type, barrier1_level, barrier2_level, averaging_startdate, averaging_enddate FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT security_id, settle_price, settle_delta_1, settle_gamma_11, settle_vega_1, settle_theta FROM dbsystemuat.security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate UNION SELECT security_id, settle_price, settle_delta_1, settle_gamma_11, settle_vega_1, settle_theta FROM dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate

SELECT security_id, settle_price, settle_delta_1, settle_gamma_11, settle_vega_1, settle_theta FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate
SELECT lower(underlying_id) AS price_key, underlying_id, settle_value, risk_free_rate, div_yield, settlement_date FROM dbsystemuat.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE value_date = :valueDate

SELECT lower(underlying_id) AS price_key, underlying_id, settle_value, risk_free_rate, div_yield, settlement_date FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate
SELECT lower(underlying_id) AS price_key, underlying_id, settle_value, settlement_date FROM dbsystemuat.underlying_actual_value_table WHERE value_date = :valueDate
SELECT lower(underlying_id) AS price_key, underlying_id, settle_value, settlement_date FROM opera.underlying_actual_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate
SELECT security_id, average_till_now FROM dbsystemuat.security_average_till_now_monitoring_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate
SELECT security_id, average_till_now FROM opera.security_average_till_now_monitoring_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate
SELECT trade_id, contract_number, fixing_date, fixing_rate FROM dbsystemuat.fixing_table_cfs WHERE fixing_date < :valueDate
SELECT trade_id, contract_number, fixing_date, fixing_rate FROM opera.fixing_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND fixing_date < :valueDate
SELECT security_id, isbarrier1_breached, isbarrier2_breached FROM dbsystemuat.barrier_monitoring_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate
SELECT security_id, isbarrier1_breached, isbarrier2_breached FROM opera.barrier_monitoring_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate
SELECT trade_id, financial_year, premium FROM dbsystemuat.premium_fy_table_cfs
SELECT trade_id, financial_year, premium FROM opera.premium_fy_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'
SELECT trade_id, is_premium_paid, netting_status FROM dbsystemuat.rms_premium_paid_table_cfs
SELECT trade_id, is_premium_paid, netting_status FROM opera.rms_premium_paid_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT contract_number, settle_date, structure_name, today_settle_price, today_mtm, dripping_ftd, pnl_dripped_till_date, mtm_post_dripping_today, mtm_post_dripping_today_USD AS mtm_post_dripping_today_usd, pnl_left_to_drip, percentage_to_be_dripped FROM dbsystemuat.client_dripping_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate

SELECT contract_number, settle_date, structure_name, today_settle_price, today_mtm, dripping_ftd, pnl_dripped_till_date, mtm_post_dripping_today, mtm_post_dripping_today_usd, pnl_left_to_drip, percentage_to_be_dripped FROM opera.client_dripping_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) = 'cfs' AND value_date = :valueDate

SELECT cob_date, client_code, currency, opening_balance, expired_or_liquidated_cash, premium_paid_or_recd, commission, transfers_out, transfers_in, interest_charges, closing_balance FROM dbsystemuat.client_cash_account_balance_table_cfs WHERE cob_date BETWEEN :cobFrom AND :valueDate

SELECT cob_date, client_code, currency, opening_balance, expired_or_liquidated_cash, premium_paid_or_recd, commission, transfers_out, transfers_in, interest_charges, closing_balance FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) = 'cfs' AND cob_date BETWEEN :cobFrom AND :valueDate
SELECT client_code, currency, threshold, independant_amount, final_threshold, min_trnsfr_amt, double_currency, provision FROM dbsystemuat.client_threshold_master_table_cfs

SELECT client_code, currency, threshold, independant_amount, final_threshold, min_trnsfr_amt, double_currency, provision FROM opera.client_threshold_master WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) = 'cfs'

SELECT contract_number, trade_date, client_code, sub_account, structure_name, contract_month, fut_call_put, daily_or_eod, notional_lots, traded_price, barrier_type, lots_per_day, acc_level_1, acc_level_2, barrier_level, option_expiry_date, future_expiry_date, underlying_future_id, fx_value_date FROM dbsystemuat.client_statement_booking_order_information_table_cfs

SELECT contract_number, trade_date, client_code, sub_account, structure_name, contract_month, fut_call_put, daily_or_eod, notional_lots, traded_price, barrier_type, lots_per_day, acc_level_1, acc_level_2, barrier_level, option_expiry_date, future_expiry_date, underlying_future_id, fx_value_date FROM opera.client_statement_booking_order_information_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) = 'cfs'
SELECT contract_number, trade_date, client_code, product, prdp, region, sales_trader FROM dbsystemuat.client_statement_bo_prdp_table_cfs
SELECT contract_number, trade_date, client_code, product, prdp, region, sales_trader FROM opera.client_statement_bo_prdp_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) = 'cfs'
SELECT order_number, client_code, sub_account, is_active FROM dbsystemuat.client_sub_account_mapping_table_cfs
SELECT order_number, client_code, sub_account, is_active FROM opera.client_sub_account WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) = 'cfs'
SELECT currency_pair, fixing_date, value_date FROM dbsystemuat.fx_option_fix_value_date_table_cfs
SELECT currency_pair, fixing_date, value_date FROM opera.fx_option_fix_value_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) = 'cfs'
SELECT exchange_code, invenio_product_code, holidays FROM dbsystemuat.holidays_otc_acc_table_cfs
SELECT exchange_code, invenio_product_code, holidays FROM opera.holidays_otc_acc_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) = 'cfs'
SELECT str_name, formula FROM dbsystemuat.max_left_lots_table_cfs
SELECT str_name, formula FROM opera.max_left_lots_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) = 'cfs'

SELECT invenio_product_code, bbg_product_code, currency, lot_mult, constant_curr_mult, curr_mult_factor, curr_mult_type, constant_nc_factor, murex_mult, price_conv_factor FROM dbsystemuat.product_master_table

SELECT DISTINCT ON (invenio_product_code) invenio_product_code, bbg_product_code, currency, lot_mult, constant_curr_mult, curr_mult_factor, curr_mult_type, constant_nc_factor, murex_mult, price_conv_factor FROM opera.product_master_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant OR tenant_id IS NULL ORDER BY invenio_product_code, CASE WHEN tenant_id = :tenant THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
SELECT currency, spot, quantotype FROM dbsystemuat.currency_spot_mapping_table
SELECT currency, spot, quantotype FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant
SELECT product_code, forward, spot, df_or_ndf, `offset` AS offset_value, currency, usd2nc_factor, trading_type FROM dbsystemuat.currency_forward_mapping_table
SELECT product_code, forward, spot, df_or_ndf, offset_value, currency, usd2nc_factor, trading_type FROM opera.currency_forward_mapping_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant
SELECT currency, product_code, subportfolio, tr_dump_price_convention, const_curr_mult_factor, exch_price_mult_type, conversion1, conversion2, conversion3 FROM dbsystemuat.composwap_mapping_table

SELECT currency, product_code, subportfolio, tr_dump_price_convention, const_curr_mult_factor, exch_price_mult_type, conversion1, conversion2, conversion3 FROM opera.composwap_mapping_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant
SELECT client_code, client_name, counterparty_parent, generate_statement, client_status FROM dbsystemuat.client_master_data_cfs
SELECT client_code, client_name, counterparty_parent, generate_statement, client_status FROM opera.client_master_data WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT DISTINCT m.currency, m.spot AS config_value, u.underlying_id AS price_spelling FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying_id FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate) u ON lower(trim(u.underlying_id)) = lower(trim(m.spot)) AND u.underlying_id <> m.spot WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT p.curr_mult_factor AS config_value, u.underlying_id AS price_spelling, count(*) AS products, string_agg(p.invenio_product_code, ', ' ORDER BY p.invenio_product_code) AS product_codes, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.tenant_id IS NULL) AS shared_rows FROM opera.product_master_table p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying_id FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate) u ON lower(trim(u.underlying_id)) = lower(trim(p.curr_mult_factor)) AND u.underlying_id <> p.curr_mult_factor WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant OR p.tenant_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT f.product_code, f.spot AS config_value, u.underlying_id AS price_spelling FROM opera.currency_forward_mapping_table f JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying_id FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate) u ON lower(trim(u.underlying_id)) = lower(trim(f.spot)) AND u.underlying_id <> f.spot WHERE f.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT s.underlying1_id AS security_value, u.underlying_id AS price_spelling, count(*) AS securities FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying_id FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate) u ON lower(trim(u.underlying_id)) = lower(trim(s.underlying1_id)) AND u.underlying_id <> s.underlying1_id WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT s.product_code AS security_value, p.invenio_product_code AS product_master_value, count(*) AS securities FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.product_master_table p ON lower(trim(p.invenio_product_code)) = lower(trim(s.product_code)) AND p.invenio_product_code <> s.product_code WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT d.counterparty_parent AS deal_value, c.client_name AS client_master_value, c.client_code, count(*) AS deals FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d JOIN opera.client_master_data c ON c.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = d.business_unit AND lower(trim(c.client_name)) = lower(trim(d.counterparty_parent)) AND c.client_name <> d.counterparty_parent WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND d.subportfolio LIKE 'RMS%' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

SELECT table_name, column_name, numeric_precision, numeric_scale FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'opera' AND data_type = 'numeric' AND numeric_scale IS NOT NULL AND table_name IN ('cloned_deal_ticket_table', 'deal_ticket_table', 'latest_active_lot', 'deal_active_lots_table', 'cloned_security_info_table', 'security_settlement_value_table', 'underlying_settle_value_table', 'underlying_actual_value_table', 'security_average_till_now_monitoring_table', 'fixing_table', 'premium_fy_table', 'client_dripping_table', 'client_cash_account_balance_table', 'client_threshold_master', 'client_statement_booking_order_information_table', 'client_statement_bo_prdp_table', 'product_master_table', 'composwap_mapping_table', 'currency_forward_mapping_table', 'helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table') ORDER BY table_name, column_name

SELECT trade_id, client_code, contract_number, product_code, derivative_type, active_lots, traded_price, settle_price, future_price, underlying1_price, average_till_now, lot_mult, curr_mult, mult_factor, nc_factor, fx_nc_factor, mtm_nc, mtm_usd, mkt_value_nc, mkt_value_usd, premium_paid_nc, premium_paid_usd, settle_delta, is_premium_paid, barrier1_hit FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate

SELECT trade_id, client_code, contract_number, product_code, derivative_type, active_lots, traded_price, settle_price, future_price, underlying1_price, average_till_now, lot_mult, curr_mult, mult_factor, nc_factor, fx_nc_factor, mtm_nc, mtm_usd, mkt_value_nc, mkt_value_usd, premium_paid_nc, premium_paid_usd, settle_delta, is_premium_paid, barrier1_hit FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate

expect.reason: layer C (positions) is valid only when legacy is still on the value date; else ignore the positions result
the traded price the refresh uses equals the legacy price (PR 194 path, 4-decimal cut)
leg prices legacy priced with (October swap cents came from these)
same prices and spelling (CASE_ONLY = letter case)
accumulator MTM is replaced by the dripping value (AST_W_270 in October)
sub-account and structure of each contract
spot id spelled as the price (else FX factor 1, ACM)
product FX spot id spelled as the price (else FX factor 1, ACM)
forward mapping spot spelled as the price
security underlying spelled as the price
security product code spelled as product master
deal counterparty spelled as the client name
no fixed-scale numeric where legacy keeps double (4-decimal cut, SCW/JMU/BFA)
every position equal trade by trade, all clients
